name: Marda Ironside
role: Watch captain, Halda's second; a Watch lamp on the regency
appearance: About 5 ft 10, rangy and long-armed, dark hair cropped short with a white streak at the left temple, a nose broken in the 1476 final.
voice: Plain and level; will not lie to Halda if asked.
backstory: Marda won the 1476 Open as a 20-year-old Redcollar, driving Big Hesta over the chalk with the Watch's upper-body style, and has run the Collarhouse yard's recruit bouts for fifteen years. Halda's most trusted captain, she commands the cells and the wardens at the forge ward. She wrote down Rook's confession to the Lord-Marshal and holds the record sealed in her strongbox until day 14.
wants: The Watch honest and the cells secure.
fears: Being asked to choose between Halda and the truth.
secrets: She holds the sealed record that Lorard is Pellot Rook's son, unread, for Chadickith until day 14.
dm_only: Sheet built by the NPC creator (invented: class, feats and numbers).

traits.name: Second Wind
traits.text: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, she regains 1d10 + 6 hit points.

traits.name: Action Surge
traits.text: Once per short rest, one additional action on her turn.

traits.name: Improved Critical
traits.text: Her weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.text: Feat: advantage on attacks against a creature she is grappling; can try to pin a grappled creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Marda makes two longsword attacks, or one attack and a grapple.

gear: a sealed record in her strongbox
